LanguageData.GoldenBooks_BookSpirit_Yanzhongzhong.des:
A half-unrolled gilded tome, worn at the cover, its spine mended a dozen times with golden thread. Yan Zhizhong, courtesy-name Yanweng — headmaster of an academy of old, a book spirit for nearly a thousand years, faithful to the old creed "books never lie".

[Aura · Lecture] Colonists within 9.9 tiles: Research Speed +15%, Learning +20%, Mood +3
[Spirit Body] Low HP but very high dodge; slowly regenerates out of combat. Highly flammable — keep away from fire and rain!

Arrives only through story events; never appears in the wild.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_BookSpirit_Zhixia.label: Book Spirit · Yan Zhixia
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_BookSpirit_Zhixia.descriptio:
A light little booklet with curled page corners, stuffed with candy wrappers, ticket stubs and scraps of paper from who-knows-when. Yan Zhixia, nickname Moji, granddaughter of Yan Zhizhong — a genius who stole the family art, forever twelve and a half.

[Aura · Rowdy Study] Colonists within 9.9 tiles: Mood +8, Learning +10%, Mental Break Threshold -5%
[Spirit Body] Low HP but very high dodge; slowly regenerates out of combat. Highly flammable — keep away from fire and rain!

Arrives only through story events; never appears in the wild.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_LectureAura.label: In the Master's Presence
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_LectureAura.description: Book spirit Yan Zhizhong lectures nearby; insight flows freely and scholarship deepens.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_NoiseStudyAura.label: Rowdy Study Hall
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_NoiseStudyAura.description: Book spirit Yan Zhixia frolics nearby; gloom melts away and spirits lift.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_SoakedBook.label: Soaked Pages
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_SoakedBook.description: The book spirit is drenched, every page heavy with water. Find shelter from the rain!
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_LostBookBox.label: Lost Crate of Books
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_LostBookBox.description: A crate of scattered books delivered by a mysterious force.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_WormSwarm.label: Bookworms on the Move
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_WormSwarm.description: A swarm of bookworms drags a crate of books toward the colony.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_YanwengMoji.label: Yan Zhizhong & Yan Zhixia
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_YanwengMoji.description:
Two book spirits — a scroll-bearing grandfather and a booklet-carrying granddaughter — take turns watching over your story.

Yanweng dislikes rushing: the first major threat arrives around day fourteen, then roughly one wave every ten-odd days. His teaching assigns homework that can actually be finished. Moji finds that boring: odd little things slip into the gaps — a crate of books "falls" nearby, bookworms are let out for some air.

Together they write your colony's every day into the Book Whispers, one volume at a time, kept with your save.

"Master. The lessons are set. Not too heavy — you can finish them."
"But old fossil! I wanna see something BIG! ...Fine. Since it's you asking."

For players who want a gentle pace — and the full book-spirit story.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_ArcaneLectern.label: Arcane Lectern
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_ArcaneLectern.description:
A mysterious lectern used for studying and dismantling books.

[Mechanics]
1. High-value books (>400) have a high chance to yield treasures.
2. Cheap books (<400) often fail but yield [Book Fragments].
3. Dismantling old books has a small chance to disturb a [Bookworm] (Hostile).

"In books, one finds houses of gold and faces as fair as jade."
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_QuanXueShi.label: Quan Xue Shi
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_QuanXueShi.description:
"In books, one finds houses of gold and thousands of bushels of millet..."

A mysterious ancient book glowing with golden light. It is the source of all miracles.

[Usage]
"Recite" this book at the Arcane Lectern to summon the True Spirit "Yan Ru Yu".
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_GoldenMillet.label: Golden Millet
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_GoldenMillet.description: Mysterious grains extracted from books. They are delicious and never rot.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_GodSpeedTalisman.label: God Speed Talisman
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_GodSpeedTalisman.description:
A red jade talisman containing the power of speed.

[Usage]
Select a colonist and right-click to use. Greatly increases movement speed for 3 days.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_BookFragment.label: Book Fragment
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_BookFragment.description: Scattered pages of ancient wisdom, usually obtained from dismantling cheap books or failed attempts.\n\nCollect 5 to compile the "Five Classics".
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_FiveClassics.label: Five Classics
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_FiveClassics.description:
A scroll of jade recording sage wisdom.

[Acquire] Compile 5 [Book Fragments].

[Usage]
Select a colonist and right-click to use. Grants an immediate random Inspiration.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Summon_YanRuYu.label: Recite: Quan Xue Shi
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Summon_YanRuYu.description: Recite the holy book to summon the True Spirit "Yan Ru Yu".
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Handbook.label: Yan Clan Handbook
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Handbook.description:
The Yan clan's thousand-year handbook, bound with candy wrappers, ticket stubs, gold thread and old years.

Select it and click "Read the Handbook" to read the full novel.

[Obtain] Unlocked by the lesson "First Steps"; or gifted by Yan Zhixia upon arrival.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Bind_Handbook.label: Bind: Yan Clan Handbook
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Bind_Handbook.description: Bind 5 book fragments with gold thread to restore the Yan clan's handbook, in which the thousand-year tale may be read at any time.
LanguageData.Extract_Knowledge_To_Wealth.label: Study: House of Gold
LanguageData.Extract_Knowledge_To_Wealth.description:
Attempt to extract Gold and Jade from books.

[Mechanics] Higher book value (>400) increases success rate. Failure yields [Book Fragments] (and may disturb Bookworms).

[Bonus] Tiny chance to attract a mortal Yan Ru Yu upon success.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Extract_Food.label: Study: Thousands of Millet
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Extract_Food.description: Attempt to extract Golden Millet from books.\n\n[Mechanics] Higher book value (>400) increases success rate. Failure yields [Book Fragments] (and may disturb Bookworms).
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Extract_Speed.label: Study: Carriages and Horses
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Extract_Speed.description: Attempt to extract God Speed Talismans from books.\n\n[Mechanics] Higher book value (>400) increases success rate. Failure yields [Book Fragments] (and may disturb Bookworms).
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Bind_FiveClassics.label: Compile: Five Classics
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Bind_FiveClassics.descriptio: Bind 5 Book Fragments into a complete set of "Five Classics".
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_BookSpiritEssence.label: Spirit Essence
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_BookSpiritEssence.descriptio:
This creature is a spirit born from the book.

- No need for food, rest, or recreation.
- Mood always maxed.
- High social impact and beauty.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_RedSleevesBuff.label: Red Sleeves Aura
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_RedSleevesBuff.description: Yan Ru Yu is studying nearby, inspiring thought and calming the mind.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_GodSpeedBuff.label: God Speed
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_GodSpeedBuff.description: Blessed by the speed of a thousand chariots.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_KnowledgeSatiated.stages.0.d: Every grain of millet I ate seemed to turn into knowledge flowing through my veins. This spiritual fullness is incredibly satisfying.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_SpiritBook_Yanzhongzhong.des:
A thick brown tome — Yanweng's own form, its golden spine-thread still wet.

The spirit within is not gone. Place it on the Arcane Lectern with book fragments to recall him.

"Turned into a book, lying quietly where I fell. Recall me when you will. — Zhizhong"
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_SpiritBook_Zhixia.label: The Book of Yan Zhixia
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_SpiritBook_Zhixia.descriptio:
A pale-blue booklet with curled corners, candy wrappers tucked inside — Moji's own form.

The spirit within is not gone. Place it on the Arcane Lectern with book fragments to recall her.

"I'm just ducking back into the book for a bit! Wait for my comeback! (๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ — Moji"
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Recall_Spirit.label: Recall: Book Spirit
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_Recall_Spirit.description: Use a spirit book (or the Quan Xue Shi) with book fragments as the catalyst to call the spirit back from its pages.\n\nAccepted: The Book of Yan Zhizhong, The Book of Yan Zhixia, Quan Xue Shi.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_SpiritVitality.label: Spirit Vitality
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_SpiritVitality.description: A book spirit eats no grain and sleeps no night — the devotion of readers is their sustenance.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_BookSpirit_Colonist.label: Colony Book Spirit
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_BookSpirit_Colonist.descript:
A page-sprite ascended from a colony scholar, pale-golden pages carrying stories written in their own name.

[Aura · Lecture] Colonists within 9.9 tiles: Research Speed +15%, Learning +20%, Mood +3
[Spirit Body] Low HP but very high dodge; slowly regenerates out of combat. Highly flammable — keep away from fire and rain!

Born of the Rite of Ascension; on death becomes a recallable spirit book.
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_SpiritBook_Colonist.label: Spirit Book
LanguageData.GoldenBooks_SpiritBook_Colonist.descript:
The book an ascended book spirit became — pale-gold cover filled with a story bearing their own name.

The spirit within is not gone. Place it on the Arcane Lectern with book fragments to recall them.

"From this day, you too are one of the book. — Yanweng"
